temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits that he has been hiding something: he is in some kind of trouble and did not know how to tell Christian.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is hiding something important from him, which makes Christian anxious and suspicious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Christian's suspicion is confirmed; Jonathan really was hiding something and is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan was hiding something important and is in some kind of trouble, but the details are still unknown.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Anxious, suspicious, then worried and concerned.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To learn more about Jonathan's trouble and decide how to help him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated, does not want to drag Christian into it, but accepts support and resources and needs help figuring a way out.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan was hiding something important and is in some kind of trouble, but the details are still unknown.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Christian now believes Jonathan's trouble is serious and complicated, and that Jonathan needs his help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in serious, complicated trouble and has accepted Christian's support; he needs resources and help to get out of it.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Jonathan by offering support and resources to resolve the trouble.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan cannot confirm whether the trouble is illegal, but admits he may have gotten involved with the wrong people and denies doing anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan's trouble may be related to criminal activity or dangerous people.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Christian's suspicion is partially confirmed and qualified: Jonathan may be entangled with dangerous people, but claims personal innocence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan's trouble likely involves criminal or dangerous people; Jonathan may not be guilty himself but is at risk.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate discreetly to learn the truth and ensure Jonathan's safety without alarming him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed; someone is trying to set him up, though the culprit is not yet identified.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan's trouble likely involves criminal or dangerous people; Jonathan may not be guilty himself but is at risk.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Christian shifts from suspecting possible criminal entanglement to believing Jonathan is innocent and being framed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is being framed by an unknown person; evidence is needed to prove his innocence.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gather more evidence to clear Jonathan's name and prove his innocence.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian identifies that the person behind the frame-up is someone close to and trusted by both him and Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed by an unknown person, and Christian is gathering evidence to prove his innocence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - the unknown framer is now believed to be a close, trusted person.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: A close and trusted person is responsible for framing Jonathan; this is a betrayal.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice.
